newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch.

text.p: * Texas Instruments Inc reported a fourth quarter net per share loss of $0.15 compared with a profit of $1.50 a year ago. The First Call estimate was for a profit of $0.68. The stock closed at 63-1/2.
* Schering-Plough Corp reported fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.76 compared with $0.66 a year ago. The First Call estimate was $0.75. The stock closed at 74.
* McDonnell Douglas Corp is expected to report fourth quarter net per share of $1.03 compared with $0.84 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 70-3/8.
* Gateway 2000 Inc is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.01 compared with $1.04 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 62-5/8.
* Schlumberger Ltd is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.98 compared with $0.69 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 110-3/8.
* McDonald's Corp is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.57 compared with $0.51 a year ago, according to First Call. Shares closed at 45-1/4.
* Delta Air Lines Inc is expected to report second quarter earnings per share of $1.40 compared with $0.93 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 82-3/4.
* United Technologies Corp reported fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.87 compared with $0.71 a year ago. The First Call estimate was $0.83. Shares closed at 66-3/4.

* Shares of PepsiCo Inc were trading at 33-1/2 in London, up from their New York close at 31-7/8 in New York following press reports that the company is on the verge of spinning off its $11 billion restaurant business.
